output.title: Attendance by program — last 8 weeks
output.sql: select week_start, program, sum(check_ins) as check_ins from v_attendance_weekly where week_start >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 56 and week_start < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date group by week_start, program order by week_start, program
output.explanation: Weekly check-ins for each program over the last 8 complete weeks (a class that serves two programs counts for both).
